list.name: kind
list.label: Type
list.query: Price / Percentage (e.g. PETR4 BOVA11) : Price / Percentage, Price / Basis points (e.g. VLCSAN3 FCYPETRP Y_GOV_US) : Price / Basis points, Linear / Basis points (e.g. SB_* SPC_* CUPOM) : Linear / Basis points, Exponential / Percentage (e.g. FWD_* BTC SOY) : Exponential / Percentage, Exponential / Basis points (e.g. SNZ STR SPC_ETF_RF) : Exponential / Basis points

list.name: factor
list.label: Factor
list.query:
SELECT fpr_name
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY fpr_name
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT instrument_id) DESC, count(DISTINCT trad_dt) DESC, fpr_name
LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Factors (latest day)
panels.description: Number of selected factors present in the latest file in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT fpr_id) AS factors
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Linked instruments (latest day)
panels.description: Instruments linked to the selected factors in the latest file in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Distinct instruments in range
panels.description: Distinct instruments linked to the selected factors at any point in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
  AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest file
panels.description: Most recent file date with data for the selected factors in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
  AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Linked instruments per factor
panels.description: Daily number of instruments linked to each selected factor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, fpr_name AS factor, count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
  AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, factor

panels.title: Net change since start of range
panels.description: Linked instruments minus each factor's count on its first day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, fpr_name AS factor, count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, factor, instruments - first_value(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY factor ORDER BY time) AS net_change
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, factor

panels.title: Daily change in linked instruments
panels.description: Linked instruments vs the factor's previous file, per selected factor.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, fpr_name AS factor, count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, factor, instruments - lag(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY factor ORDER BY time) AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, factor, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, factor

panels.title: Linked instruments, stacked by factor
panels.description: Daily linked instruments of the selected factors, stacked so the top edge is the total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, fpr_name AS factor, count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
  AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, factor

panels.title: Instrument links added / removed
panels.description: Factor-instrument links of the selected factors added and removed vs the previous file.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, fpr_id, instrument_id
  FROM src
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
),
dates AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM src)
),
added AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT d.*, dates.prev_dt FROM d JOIN dates USING (trad_dt)) c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.fpr_id = c.fpr_id AND p.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
removed AS (
  SELECT r.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT dates.trad_dt, p.fpr_id, p.instrument_id FROM dates JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = dates.prev_dt) r
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = r.trad_dt AND c.fpr_id = r.fpr_id AND c.instrument_id = r.instrument_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  coalesce(a.n, 0)::BIGINT AS added,
  -coalesce(r.n, 0)::BIGINT AS removed
FROM dates
LEFT JOIN added a USING (trad_dt)
LEFT JOIN removed r USING (trad_dt)
WHERE dates.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Selected factors (latest day in range)
panels.description: Attributes and linked instruments of the selected factors on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE fpr_name IN ($factor)
    AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
span AS (
  SELECT fpr_id,
    min(trad_dt)::TIMESTAMP AS first_seen,
    count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days_in_range,
    count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments_in_range
  FROM d
  GROUP BY fpr_id
)
SELECT
  d.fpr_id,
  any_value(d.fpr_name) AS factor,
  any_value(concat_ws(' / ', d.capitalization, d.variation_format)) AS type,
  any_value(d.day_count_base) AS day_count_base,
  any_value(d.interpolation_base) AS interpolation_base,
  any_value(d.fpr_group_id) AS fpr_group_id,
  count(DISTINCT d.instrument_id) AS instruments,
  string_agg(DISTINCT d.instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY d.instrument_id::VARCHAR) AS instrument_ids,
  any_value(span.instruments_in_range) AS instruments_in_range,
  any_value(span.days_in_range) AS days_in_range,
  any_value(span.first_seen) AS first_seen
FROM d
JOIN span USING (fpr_id)
WHERE d.trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY d.fpr_id
ORDER BY factor

panels.title: Factors per day by type
panels.description: Daily number of factors in each type, stacked so the top edge is the file total; ignores both filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) AS kind, count(DISTINCT fpr_id) AS factors
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, kind

panels.title: Factors added / removed
panels.description: Factors of the selected types added and removed vs the previous file; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, fpr_id
  FROM src
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
),
dates AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM src)
),
added AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT d.*, dates.prev_dt FROM d JOIN dates USING (trad_dt)) c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.fpr_id = c.fpr_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
removed AS (
  SELECT r.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT dates.trad_dt, p.fpr_id FROM dates JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = dates.prev_dt) r
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = r.trad_dt AND c.fpr_id = r.fpr_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  coalesce(a.n, 0)::BIGINT AS added,
  -coalesce(r.n, 0)::BIGINT AS removed
FROM dates
LEFT JOIN added a USING (trad_dt)
LEFT JOIN removed r USING (trad_dt)
WHERE dates.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Most linked instruments (range)
panels.description: Top 20 factors of the selected types by distinct linked instruments in the range; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  fpr_name AS factor,
  count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments_in_range,
  arg_max(instrument_id, trad_dt)::VARCHAR AS latest_instrument,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days_in_range
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY fpr_name
ORDER BY instruments_in_range DESC, days_in_range DESC, factor
LIMIT 20

panels.title: New factors (first seen in range)
panels.description: Factors of the selected types whose first file falls in the range; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
),
f AS (
  SELECT
    fpr_name AS factor,
    any_value(concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format)) AS type,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen
  FROM src
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  GROUP BY fpr_name
)
SELECT factor, type, first_seen::TIMESTAMP AS first_seen, last_seen::TIMESTAMP AS last_seen
FROM f
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen::TIMESTAMP)
  AND first_seen > (SELECT min(trad_dt) FROM src)
ORDER BY first_seen DESC, factor
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Dropped factors (last seen in range)
panels.description: Factors of the selected types whose last file falls in the range; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
),
f AS (
  SELECT
    fpr_name AS factor,
    any_value(concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format)) AS type,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen
  FROM src
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  GROUP BY fpr_name
)
SELECT factor, type, first_seen::TIMESTAMP AS first_seen, last_seen::TIMESTAMP AS last_seen
FROM f
WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen::TIMESTAMP)
  AND last_seen < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM src)
ORDER BY last_seen DESC, factor
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Factors by type and base (latest day)
panels.description: Factors of the selected types by capitalization, format and day-count / interpolation base on the latest day; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format, coalesce(day_count_base::VARCHAR || '/' || interpolation_base::VARCHAR, 'no base')) AS category,
  count(DISTINCT fpr_id) AS factors
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY factors DESC

panels.title: Factor changes in range
panels.description: Factors of the selected types added or removed vs the previous file; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, fpr_id,
    any_value(fpr_name) AS factor,
    any_value(concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format)) AS type,
    any_value(day_count_base) AS day_count_base,
    any_value(interpolation_base) AS interpolation_base,
    string_agg(DISTINCT instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY instrument_id::VARCHAR) AS instrument_ids
  FROM src
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  GROUP BY trad_dt, fpr_id
),
dates AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM src)
),
changes AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, 'added' AS change, c.* EXCLUDE (trad_dt, prev_dt)
  FROM (SELECT d.*, dates.prev_dt FROM d JOIN dates USING (trad_dt)) c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.fpr_id = c.fpr_id
  WHERE c.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT r.cur_dt AS trad_dt, 'removed' AS change, r.* EXCLUDE (trad_dt, cur_dt)
  FROM (SELECT p.*, dates.trad_dt AS cur_dt FROM dates JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = dates.prev_dt) r
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = r.cur_dt AND c.fpr_id = r.fpr_id
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS trad_dt, change, fpr_id, factor, type, day_count_base, interpolation_base, instrument_ids
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY trad_dt DESC, change, factor
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: All factors in selected types (latest day in range)
panels.description: Every factor of the selected types on the latest day, to browse names for the factor filter; ignores the factor filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT fpr_id,
  any_value(fpr_name) AS factor,
  any_value(concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format)) AS type,
  any_value(day_count_base) AS day_count_base,
  any_value(interpolation_base) AS interpolation_base,
  any_value(fpr_group_id) AS fpr_group_id,
  count(DISTINCT instrument_id) AS instruments,
  string_agg(DISTINCT instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY instrument_id::VARCHAR) AS instrument_ids
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY fpr_id
ORDER BY type, factor
LIMIT 5000

panels.title: $factor linked instruments
panels.description: Every instrument linked to the factor in the range with its first and last file, one panel per selected factor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  min(trad_dt)::TIMESTAMP AS first_seen,
  max(trad_dt)::TIMESTAMP AS last_seen,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days,
  max(trad_dt) = max(max(trad_dt)) OVER () AS current
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE fpr_name = $factor
  AND concat_ws(' / ', capitalization, variation_format) IN ($kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY instrument_id
ORDER BY first_seen DESC, instrument_id
